messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 22 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system will be unavailable from 18:00 on Saturday 22 November until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and an iManage upgrade. Please save and close all documents before 18:00. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
